recognize_zh: 這是 CD45 對 SSC 的流式圖：芽細胞 gate（CD45 dim、低 SSC）佔 13.26%，其中綠色為異常芽細胞群，單核球僅 0.30% 幾乎消失；CD45 dim 芽細胞明顯增加而正常單核球缺乏，是後續判讀 BPDCN 表現型的起點。
features: Dot plot: CD45-KO (x-axis) versus side scatter (y-axis), gated on live events
Blast gate (dim CD45, low SSC) comprises 13.26% and contains a dominant green abnormal population
Granulocytes 15.27% with high SSC and moderate CD45
Lymphocyte gate (bright CD45, low SSC) adjacent to the blast gate
Large CD45-negative low-SSC population (gray) consistent with nucleated red cells/debris
describe_en: Flow cytometric CD45 versus side scatter plot of live events shows an expanded blast region with dim CD45 and low side scatter comprising 13.26% of events, occupied predominantly by an abnormal (green) population. Granulocytes account for 15.27% and monocytes are nearly absent at 0.30%, with a lymphocyte cluster adjacent to the blast gate and a large CD45-negative population consistent with erythroid precursors or debris. This plot establishes gating only and does not assign lineage. Subsequent analysis of the green population for CD4, CD56, CD123, HLA-DR and lack of CD34 and lineage markers is needed to support blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: AML blasts share the CD45-dim/low SSC location but typically express CD34/CD117, CD13/CD33 or MPO rather than CD4/CD56/CD123-bright without CD34.
Lymphoblasts also fall in the CD45-dim region but express TdT with CD19/CD22 or cytoplasmic CD3.
